name: Crossroads: Brumbof Bramstum hands over the drumstick on his second gossip page
contract: Issue #7422, live CoA recording (FloridaManLootGoblin L3eJpDS8ddY, 2026-08-11, 21:00-21:05): Brumbof Bramstum 753513's first page reads '<The drummer is busy playing his drum. He doesn't seem to notice you.>' and, while 'Dancing to the Beat' 255080 is taken without a Drumstick 355122, offers 'Excuse me, friend. I need a drumstick for someone, do you have one you can spare?'. Choosing it adds the Drumstick and opens a second page, 'I didn't realize there was another drummer here at the Crossroads. ... after the party!', with no further options, instead of closing the window.
